    model.train()

    logits= model(None, feats)
    out = logits.log_softmax(dim=1)
    loss_l = criterion_l(out[idx], labels[idx])
    loss_t = criterion_t((logits/param['tau']).log_softmax(dim=1), (out_t_all/param['tau']).log_softmax(dim=1))

    values_delta = torch.tensor(Delta.data, dtype=torch.float32, device='cuda')
    indices_delta = torch.tensor([Delta.row, Delta.col], dtype=torch.int64, device='cuda')
    Delta_sparse = torch.sparse_coo_tensor(indices_delta, values_delta, size=Delta.shape, dtype=torch.float32)
    smooth_emb = torch.sparse.mm(Delta_sparse, logits)
    row_l2_norms = torch.norm(smooth_emb, p=2, dim=1)
    l21_norm = torch.norm(row_l2_norms, p=1)
    loss_proposed_unfairness = l21_norm
  
    adj_sparse = torch.tensor(adj, dtype=torch.float32).to_sparse()
    loss_energy = compute_loss_energy(adj_sparse, logits, node_energy_teacher, edge_idx, batch_size=500000)
  
    loss = loss_l * param['lamb'] + loss_t * (1 - param['lamb']) + loss_energy * beta + gamma* loss_proposed_unfairness
    optimizer.zero_grad()
    loss.backward(retain_graph=True)
    optimizer.step() 
  
    return loss_l.item() * param['lamb'], loss_t.item() * (1-param['lamb']) + loss_energy.item() *beta + gamma* loss_proposed_unfairness.item()

def train_teacher(param, model, g, feats, labels, indices, criterion, evaluator, optimizer):
    device = torch.device('cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu')
    if param['exp_setting'] == 'tran':
        idx_train, idx_val, idx_test = indices
      
        adj_1 = g.adjacency_matrix()                       
        row_1 = adj_1.indices()[0].numpy()
        col_1 = adj_1.indices()[1].numpy()
        values_1 = adj_1.val
        adj_mat_1 = coo_matrix((values_1,(row_1,col_1)),shape=adj_1.shape)
        adj_mat_final = adj_mat_1.toarray()   
        adj_mat_final_t = torch.tensor(adj_mat_final, dtype=torch.float32)
    else:
        obs_idx_train, obs_idx_val, obs_idx_test, idx_obs, idx_test_ind = indices
        obs_feats = feats[idx_obs]
        obs_labels = labels[idx_obs]
        obs_g = g.subgraph(idx_obs).to(device)

    g = g.to(device)

    es = 0
    val_best = 0
    test_val = 0
    test_best = 0

    for epoch in range(1, param["max_epoch"] + 1):
        if param['exp_setting'] == 'tran':
            train_loss = train(model, g, feats, labels, criterion, optimizer,adj_mat_final, idx_train)
            logits_e, out = evaluate(model, g, feats)
                 
            IF = get_IF(logits_e,feats, adj_mat_final)
            train_acc = evaluator(out[idx_train], labels[idx_train])
            val_acc = evaluator(out[idx_val], labels[idx_val])
            test_acc = evaluator(out[idx_test], labels[idx_test])
        else:
            train_loss = train(model, obs_g, obs_feats, obs_labels, criterion, optimizer, obs_idx_train)
            _, obs_out = evaluate(model, obs_g, obs_feats)
            train_acc = evaluator(obs_out[obs_idx_train], obs_labels[obs_idx_train])
            val_acc = evaluator(obs_out[obs_idx_val], obs_labels[obs_idx_val])
            _, out = evaluate(model, g, feats)
            test_acc = evaluator(out[idx_test_ind], labels[idx_test_ind])

        if epoch % 1 == 0:

            print("\033[0;30;46m [{}] CLA: {:.5f} | Train: {:.4f}, Val: {:.4f}, Test: {:.4f} | Val Best: {:.4f}, Test Val: {:.4f}, Test Best: {:.4f} | IF: {:.4f}\033[0m".format(
    epoch, train_loss, train_acc, val_acc, test_acc, val_best, test_val, test_best, IF))


        if test_acc > test_best:
            test_best = test_acc

        if val_acc >= val_best:
            val_best = val_acc
            test_val = test_acc
            best_IF = IF
            state = copy.deepcopy(model.state_dict())
            es = 0
        else:
            es += 1
            
        if es == 50:
            print("Early stopping!")
            break

    model.load_state_dict(state)
    model.eval()
    print(f"Best Validation Accuracy: {val_best:.4f}, Test Accuracy: {test_val:.4f}, IF: {best_IF:.4f}")

    if param['exp_setting'] == 'tran':
        out, _ = evaluate(model, g, feats)    
        device = out.to(device)
        adj_mat_final_t = adj_mat_final_t.to(device)
        row, col = torch.nonzero(adj_mat_final_t, as_tuple=True)  
        values = adj_mat_final_t[row, col]  
        diff_teacher = out[row] - out[col]  
        squared_diff_teacher = torch.sum(diff_teacher**2, dim=1)  
        weighted_diff_teacher = values * squared_diff_teacher  
        node_energy_teacher = torch.zeros(out.size(0)).to(device)
        node_energy_teacher = node_energy_teacher.index_add(0, row, weighted_diff_teacher)

    else:
        obs_out, _ = evaluate(model, obs_g, obs_feats)
        out, _ = evaluate(model, g, feats)
        out[idx_obs] = obs_out
    return out, test_acc, test_val, test_best, state,node_energy_teacher,best_IF

def run_seed(name, seed, output, max_epochs=None):
    destination = output / name / f'seed{seed}'
    destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    complete = destination / 'metrics.json'
    if complete.exists():
        previous = json.loads(complete.read_text())
        assert previous['requested_epochs'] == max_epochs
        return previous
    param = json.loads((ROOT / 'upstream/param/best_parameters.json').read_text())[name]['tran']['SAGE']
    param['seed'] = seed
    if max_epochs is not None:
        param['max_epoch'] = max_epochs
    start = time.perf_counter()
    with (destination / 'training.log').open('w') as stream, contextlib.redirect_stdout(stream):
        released_utils.set_seed(seed)
        graph, labels, train, valid, test = released_data.load_data(name, seed=seed)
        assert len(valid) == 500
        assert not (set(train.tolist()) & set(valid.tolist()) or set(train.tolist()) & set(test.tolist()) or set(valid.tolist()) & set(test.tolist()))
        features = graph.ndata['feat']
        param['feat_dim'] = features.shape[1]
        param['label_dim'] = labels.int().max().item() + 1
        write_json(destination / 'config.json', param)
        write_json(destination / 'split.json', dict(train=train.tolist(), validation=valid.tolist(), test=test.tolist(), nodes=graph.num_nodes(), directed_edges_with_loops=graph.num_edges()))
        loss_l = torch.nn.NLLLoss()
        loss_t = torch.nn.KLDivLoss(reduction='batchmean', log_target=True)
        evaluator = released_utils.get_evaluator(name)
        model_t = released_models.Model(param, model_type='teacher')
        model_t.encoder.dropout = _CUDADropoutBridge(param['dropout_t'])
        cpu_rng_after_teacher_init = torch.get_rng_state().clone()
        optimizer_t = torch.optim.Adam(model_t.parameters(), lr=.01, weight_decay=param['weight_decay'])
        STATIC.clear()
        teacher_result = released_training.train_teacher(param, model_t, graph, features, labels, (train, valid, test), loss_l, evaluator, optimizer_t)
        logits_t, _, teacher_accuracy, _, _, energy, teacher_if = teacher_result
        assert torch.equal(cpu_rng_after_teacher_init, torch.get_rng_state()), "Teacher changed CPU RNG stream"
        torch.save(dict(state=model_t.state_dict(), logits=logits_t, energy=energy), destination / 'teacher.pt')
        # Source initialization consumes random feature noise before student creation.
        kd_model = released_models.Com_KD_Prob(param)
        kd_model.initialization(model_t, graph, features)
        features, labels = features.cuda(), labels.cuda()
        logits_t, energy = logits_t.cuda(), energy.cuda()
        student = released_models.Model(param, model_type='student').cuda()
        init = copy.deepcopy(student.state_dict())
        torch_state = torch.random.get_rng_state()
        cuda_state = torch.cuda.get_rng_state()
        np_state = np.random.get_state()
        import random
        python_state = random.getstate()
        values = {}
        for method, beta, gamma in [('FAITH', .02, GAMMA[name]), ('KL_ablation', 0., 0.)]:
            student.load_state_dict(init)
            torch.random.set_rng_state(torch_state)
            torch.cuda.set_rng_state(cuda_state)
            np.random.set_state(np_state)
            random.setstate(python_state)
            released_training.beta, released_training.gamma = beta, gamma
            optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(student.parameters(), lr=param['learning_rate'], weight_decay=param['weight_decay'])
            STATIC.clear()
            print(f'REPRODUCTION METHOD {method}', flush=True)
            outcome = released_training.train_student(param, student, graph, features, labels, logits_t, (train, valid, test), loss_l, loss_t, evaluator, optimizer, energy, copy.deepcopy(kd_model))
            logits, _, validation_selected_test, _, state, metric_if = outcome
            checked = evaluator(logits[test].log_softmax(1), labels[test])
            assert checked == validation_selected_test
            values[method] = dict(accuracy=checked, individual_unfairness=metric_if, beta=beta, gamma=gamma)
            torch.save(dict(state=state, logits=logits), destination / f'{method}.pt')
        result = dict(dataset=name, seed=seed, requested_epochs=max_epochs, teacher_accuracy=teacher_accuracy, teacher_individual_unfairness=teacher_if, methods=values, seconds=time.perf_counter()-start, validation_nodes=len(valid), device='cpu_dgl_cuda_dropout_and_student')
        write_json(complete, result)
    print(json.dumps(result), flush=True)
    return result
